what: React watch page behind Caddy (https-check.mjs --quality-repeats 12): seconds the video advanced in the 3 s after each switch to 480p; "stalled" = 1.5 s or less (the H4a criterion)
host: one Windows PC, loopback/tailnet, shared with other programs (the 480p encoder, Edge and the game run on it)
relayTiming: Caddy access log of the same sessions: in every switch, stalled ones included, the 480p playlist and first media requests were answered within about 10-20 ms by either backend (non-blocking requests, first 3 s of each switch). The stalls are therefore not relay response delays.
conclusion: An intermittent stall right after a quality switch exists with both backends; the sample is too small to tell the backends apart. Cause not identified (player level switch / encoder timing on a loaded PC).
